from ortools.sat.python import cp_model

n = 14
model = cp_model.CpModel()

x = [model.NewIntVar(0, n-1, f'x{i}') for i in range(n)]
d = [model.NewIntVar(1, n-1, f'd{i}') for i in range(n-1)]

# All-different
model.AddAllDifferent(x)
model.AddAllDifferent(d)

# Link d and x
for i in range(n-1):
    # d[i] = |x[i+1] - x[i]|
    model.AddAbsEquality(d[i], x[i+1] - x[i])

# Partial assignments
model.Add(x[6] == 3)
model.Add(x[12] == 6)
model.Add(d[3] == 10)
model.Add(d[11] == 2)

solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 30.0
solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8

status = solver.Solve(model)
print('Status', status, cp_model.CpStatus().Name(status))
if status == cp_model.OPTIMAL or status == cp_model.FEASIBLE:
    xs = [solver.Value(x[i]) for i in range(n)]
    ds = [solver.Value(d[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    print('x:', xs)
    print('d:', ds)
    # verify
    assert sorted(xs) == list(range(n))
    assert sorted(ds) == list(range(1, n))
    for i in range(n-1):
        assert ds[i] == abs(xs[i+1] - xs[i])
    print('Verified')
else:
    print('No solution found')
